name: Benimaru
source:
Age unknown.
Likes: Meat
Dislikes: Idiots

[url=/c46989]Aoi's[/url] shikigami, he's served her clan for hundreds of years. He usually dwells in a red sword.
He's actually a demon who eats humans.
He has a bad mouth and often calls Aoi an idiot.
When Aoi was summoned to the other world he mysteriously disappeared.

[Only capturable if playing as Aoi]
